title: Scheduling the Unschedulable: Taming Black-Box LLM Inference at Scale
authors: Renzhong Yuan; Yijun Zeng; Xiaosong Gao; Linxi Yu; Haochun Liao; Han Wang
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Length prediction, SLO admission, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: When LLM inference is consumed through hosted black-box APIs, the client cannot reorder or preempt in-flight requests and the provider's internal scheduling is opaque; without per-request output-length priors, classical size-aware or weighted fair queueing cannot transfer to the API boundary. The question is what becomes possible at the client side once coarse output-length predictors (e.g. SageSched) make scheduling semi-clairvoyant.
problem_statement.zh: 當 LLM 推論透過託管的黑盒 API 消費時，客戶端無法重排或搶占 in-flight request，提供方內部排程亦不可觀察；缺乏 per-request 輸出長度先驗時，傳統 size-aware 或加權公平排隊無法跨越此 API 邊界。本研究探討：在 SageSched 等粗粒度輸出長度預測器讓排程具備 semi-clairvoyant 特性後，客戶端能做到什麼。

key_innovation.en: A three-layer client-side scheduling decomposition for token-predictable black-box LLM APIs: (i) Allocation via congestion-aware adaptive Deficit Round Robin (DRR) over size classes; (ii) Ordering via slowdown-aware feasible-set scoring score=w*(wait/cost) - w*(size/ref) + w*urgency; (iii) Overload control via an explicit admit/defer/reject cost ladder gated by a severity score combining provider load, queue pressure, and tail-latency ratio. The design treats coarse token priors as a first-class scheduling input.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 token 可預測的黑盒 LLM API，提出三層客戶端排程分解：(i) Allocation 採壅塞感知的自適應 Deficit Round Robin（DRR）跨類別配額；(ii) Ordering 採 slowdown-aware feasible-set 評分 score=w*(wait/cost) - w*(size/ref) + w*urgency；(iii) Overload control 以 admit/defer/reject 的成本梯度判定，閾值由 provider_load、queue_pressure 與 tail_latency_ratio 合成的 severity score 觸發。此設計將粗粒度 token 先驗視為一等公民的排程輸入。

baselines_compared: FIFO (direct dispatch), quota-tiered, naive class-only routing

key_improvements.en: Under balanced/high congestion the full stack achieves 100% completion, 100% deadline satisfaction, and 4.2+/-1.6 SLO-meeting goodput req/s with short-request P95 within tens of milliseconds. On ShareGPT replay: 4.4x short-P95 improvement over naive dispatch (330 vs 1449 ms) and 1.9x global-P95 reduction (17470 vs 33337 ms). Removing magnitude information inflates short-request P95 by up to 5.8x.
key_improvements.zh: 在 balanced/high 壅塞情境下，完整堆疊達成 100% 完成率、100% 截止期滿足率，以及 4.2+/-1.6 req/s 的 SLO 達標 goodput，且短 request P95 控制在數十 ms。在 ShareGPT replay 中：短 request P95 相較 naive dispatch 改善 4.4x（330 vs 1449 ms）、全域 P95 降低 1.9x（17470 vs 33337 ms）。移除幅度資訊會使短 request P95 膨脹最高 5.8x。

reported_accuracy: Latency calibration on Volcengine Doubao yields latency_ms = 3294 + 18.7 x output_tokens with R^2 = 0.97; predictor-noise sweep confirms graceful degradation up to 60% multiplicative error on coarse priors
models_validated: Volcengine Doubao (used only for latency calibration of the mock provider)
validation_workloads: Synthetic balanced/heavy-dominated mixes x medium/high congestion (5 seeds each), ShareGPT-English real-trace validation

scope_assumptions.en: Client-side scheduler only; assumes the provider is an opaque black-box API whose internal state is hidden and in-flight requests cannot be preempted. Output-length priors are coarse (token magnitudes from SageSched-style predictor), not oracle; the formulation rests on output-length predictability. Mock provider is an abstraction calibrated to a single LLM API (Volcengine Doubao) under low load, not a faithful model of any specific vendor. Authors explicitly cite this as a boundary condition: the same code reduces to blind budgeting if magnitude priors are unavailable.
scope_assumptions.zh: 純客戶端排程器；假設 provider 為黑盒 API，內部狀態不可見、in-flight request 無法被搶占。輸出長度先驗為粗粒度（SageSched 風格的 token magnitude），非 oracle；整個論點立基於輸出長度可預測性。Mock provider 為抽象化模型，僅以單一 LLM API（Volcengine Doubao）低負載校準，並非任何 vendor 的忠實模型。作者明白指出此為邊界條件：若無 magnitude 先驗，同一份程式碼將退化為盲目預算分配。
